text:
maya: PartnerX reported ~4% credits missing when fallback routing to 'basic' SKU occurs. Saw it in their weekly bill this morning. Anyone seen this pattern? cc @suresh @jonathan

jonathan: I saw an alert from marketplace-ack yesterday, might be ack window + timezone + fallback SKU mapping. Can you paste a sample usage id so I can grep logs?

maya: Copied sanitized example from PartnerX: usage_id=px-82421, partner_id=px, plan=enterprise-us, fallback_to=basic, reported_units=0.25, billed_units=0.0

suresh: Two quick hypotheses: 1) our fallback transform sets sku=null in some edgecases so marketplace treats as free, 2) dedupe/window logic drops the final message. I'll grep ingest logs for px-82421 and region=us-east.

oliver: I'll kick off a targeted reconciliation for px-82421 and the last 7 days. Note: current backfill is "first-seen wins" which could pick a lower-price fallback. Might need prefer_highest_price flag.

suresh: Found log entry: `marketplace-ingest` -> "no_sku_match" for px-82421 because partner_sku_map has no entry for enterprise-us -> enterprise (region suffix mismatch). Patch idea: add partner_sku_overrides lookup.

anna: Policy: if our fallback mapping produced a free/zero-billed event, should we auto-credit the customer or wait for partner replay? My thought: auto-credit for enterprise cases within 72h and reverse if partner replay comes later. Need audit trail + partner notification.

jonathan: +1. For enterprise partners we should auto-credit and deduct later. Also require idempotency header from partner webhooks: `X-Redwood-Idempotency`. Add a reconciliation tag on events so backfill can be deterministic.

maya: Can we implement a temporary ingest transform that preserves original payload but sets a synthetic sku so billing doesn't get zeroed? E.g. set `meta.generated_fallback=true` so we can reverse later.

suresh: Yup. Landing a small transform in staging now. Example transform snippet:

```
if (!event.sku) {
  event.sku = partner_default_sku || 'basic';
  event.meta = event.meta || {};
  event.meta.generated_fallback = true;
}
// emit processed event with fallback_source: 'ingest-transform'
```

We'll emit `fallback_source` and `generated_fallback` so the reconciler can prefer partner-sent SKUs when present.

partner-bot: Webhook delivery summary for PartnerX (24h): 98.7% 200, 1.1% 400 (payload mismatch), 0.2% 5xx. Partner replay endpoint (internal): https://partners.partnerx.com/replay

oliver: Plan: 1) add mapping migration to partner_sku_overrides, 2) run backfill with `prefer_highest_price=true`, 3) mark auto-credits applied and tag events with `recon:manual-credit`. ETA for backfill run: tomorrow EOD PST. I'll open a ticket and assign.

anna: Also add connector unit test: send event with null sku + region override mismatch and assert `generated_fallback` is set and that the processed event has `sku='basic'` fallback. PR for mapping change needs migration and tests.

jonathan: I'll own rollout: feature-flag `fallback-mapping` -> canary 10% -> 100% with monitoring on billing delta & webhook 4xx rate. Add a dashboard: billing.diff.partnerX, ingest.errors, backfill.success_rate.

maya: Thanks all. @oliver please ping PartnerX CSM once credits applied. I'll draft partner-facing note and add link to the recon playbook: https://docs.redwood.com/marketplace-metering/recon-playbook. Followups: mapping migration, backfill job, policy email. :white_check_mark:
